gwt: Given Cursor on Windows with no npx on GUI PATH, When MCP and hooks start, Then both launch via absolute node path.
Given Pi, When context-mode adds a hint, Then it is a system or custom-role message, never role user.
Given a server running 1 hour, When the liveness guard ticks, Then zero child processes are spawned (stdin close or signal only).
Given a plain ls command, When hooks run, Then PreToolUse is not spawned or takes under 15 ms, and PostToolUse runs async and append-only.
Given 500 session databases, When the server idles 10 minutes, Then no database file is opened and nothing is written.
Given a generated hook config for any adapter, Then each entry has a timeout field of 10 seconds or less.
Given a release build, When npm audit --omit=dev runs, Then it finds zero high or critical issues.
Given hooks.json, When each matcher is tested against real tool names, Then each matcher matches at least one tool; doctor checks this.
Given the docs set, When each supported host is checked, Then each host has an install section.
Given Windows, When ctx_execute shell runs gh --version, Then it resolves.
Given sibling databases, When ctx_stats runs, Then every open is read-only and modification times stay unchanged.
Given tool PowerShell, When PreToolUse fires, Then it gets the same hint as Bash.
Given Codex sessions A in directory X and B in directory Y 6 minutes apart, Then session A allows only X and session B allows only Y.
Given only a pyenv-win shim, When ctx_execute python runs, Then it runs, or the error names the shim.
Given a generated agy hooks.json, When it is checked against the agy schema, Then it passes.
Given an adapter bundle copied alone to a temp directory, When it loads, Then there is no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND error.
Given each parameter the schema declares, When ctx_search is called with it, Then no validation error occurs.
Given OpenCode 2.x, When the plugin loads, Then the default export has an id and a setup function.
Given Windows, When ctx_stats is called, Then it finishes in under 300 ms and startup spawns no synchronous probes.
Given two worktrees, When ctx_search runs, Then hits are labelled by worktree and the caller's own session ranks first.
Given Pi and Claude Code, When a Read of a file over 50 KB runs, Then both emit the same hint text.
Given a deny rule for Read(~/secret/**), When ctx_execute_file reads a file under ~/secret, Then it is denied; the same holds for a //abs/** rule.
Given two queries that hit the same chunk, When ctx_batch_execute returns, Then that chunk appears only once.
Given the tool list, When the schema is read, Then the timeout description states milliseconds, or the field is named timeout_ms.
Given OpenCode, When SessionStart lines are injected, Then output.system length stays the same because lines merge into one entry.
Given install under Homebrew node, When plugin.json is written, Then the command is node, not a pinned process path.
Given Pi, When ctx_execute returns, Then the first line is plain text, not a code-fence opener.
Given tools/list fails once, When the next before_agent_start fires, Then bootstrap runs again and tools register.
Given a server on stdio, When stdin closes, Then the process exits within 2 seconds.
Given same session id, When 3 Reads fire, Then hint shows once and no /tmp dirs are made.
Given a multi-request turn, When request 2 is built, Then its prefix equals request 1.
Given shell code `for i in 1; do echo $i; done`, When ctx_execute runs, Then output is `1`.
Given limit=-1, When ctx_search runs, Then it errors (or clamps to 1).
Given fetch fails, When ctx_fetch_and_index returns, Then text has no stack frames.

Given page with `
`, When fetched, Then it indexes without error.
Given settings.json env `X_TOKEN=abc`, When doctor/debug runs, Then `abc` is absent from output.
Given allow rule for ctx_execute, When called without cwd, Then no permission prompt (hook returns no updatedInput).
Given Pi, When ctx_execute is called, Then call row shows language and first code line.
Given readFileSync of a 1MB PNG, When stats update, Then saved tokens do not include it.
Given no `[features].hooks`, When codex reports hooks true, Then doctor passes.
Given cold start, When initialize arrives, Then reply < 1 s with no PATH probes run.
Given text with emoji at a cut, When snippet returns, Then it is valid UTF-8.
Given Pi 0.85, When doctor runs, Then it reports the actual extension path.
Given running ctx_execute, When client cancels, Then child is killed within 1 s and a cancel reply returns.
Given Pi, When context hook injects, Then message has a finite timestamp.
Given a batch command that spawns a node grandchild asserting empty stderr, When run via ctx_batch_execute, Then the grandchild stderr is empty and the byte count is still reported.
Given ctx_execute on any adapter, When result returns, Then line 1 is a plain summary/output, not a code fence.
Given install then uninstall, When settings/hooks dirs are diffed, Then no context-mode entry, file or process remains.
Given OpenCode calls `webfetch`, When PreToolUse runs, Then the WebFetch hint is emitted.
Given HTTPS_PROXY set, When ctx_fetch_and_index runs, Then the request goes through the proxy.
Given 3 step-finish events in one turn, When journaled, Then turn cost counted once.
Given Remote-WSL workspace in MCP roots, When ctx_execute_file reads a workspace file, Then it is allowed.
Given the tool-description token budget constant, When descriptions are linted, Then total size stays under budget on every adapter.
Given 10,001 B stdout and 3,284 B returned, When stats computed, Then denominator counts returned bytes once.
Given stats report, When rendered, Then ratios are labelled as bytes, no time claim.
Given standalone MCP install, When hint emitted, Then it names `mcp__context-mode__*`.
Given Copilot CLI cwd=/repo, When ctx_execute_file reads /repo/AGENTS.md, Then allowed.
Given a generated hooks.json, when read, then every tool name matches exactly one hook entry and each hook entry carries a timeout.
Given an idle server for 60 seconds, when CPU time is measured, then it grows by less than 1 second; when the client closes stdin, then the process exits.
Given Pi reloads twice, when the MCP helper processes are counted, then exactly one remains.
Given a Windows client is killed, when 5 seconds pass, then the server process has exited.
Given a command that prints 100 MiB, when ctx_batch_execute runs, then indexed bytes stay under max_total_indexed_bytes and the reply states it was cut.
Given a call to mcp__grafana__get_datasource, when PreToolUse runs, then no hook process is spawned.
Given ctx_execute runs sleep 999, when the host sends cancel or the timeout hits, then the child process tree is dead within 2 seconds and the tool returns an error.
Given a registered external git worktree, when ctx_execute_file and ctx_batch_execute target it, then both accept under the same containment rule.
Given the host closes stdio, when 5 seconds pass, then the server process has exited and the plugin directory can be deleted on Windows.
Given server A has exited, when server B runs node -v in ctx_batch_execute, then it succeeds with no MODULE_NOT_FOUND error.
Given any stats render, when totals are computed, then session kept-out is at most project total, project total is at most all-time total, and zero calls give zero savings.
Given a timeout of 5000 ms and a huge output, when ctx_batch_execute runs, then the reply returns within 5 seconds plus a small margin.
Given ctx_execute is called with no timeoutMs and the code loops forever, then the server itself sets no default timeout and the host's own RPC timeout governs the call.
Given the command `if true; then echo ok; fi`, when ctx_batch_execute runs with env passed through spawn env, then the output is ok.
Given the server is started in /proj, when it runs, then process.cwd() stays /proj.
Given 2 jobs and a concurrency of 8, when runPool computes the capped flag, then capped is false.
Given text with an emoji at the cut boundary, when it is truncated, then the result has no lone surrogate.
Given search hits from session, worktree and project scope, when ranked, then session hits rank above worktree hits and worktree hits rank above project hits.
Given the built bundle, when grepped, then no with-type-json import attribute exists.
Given npm pack, when the file list is read, then every file referenced at runtime is present.
Given a 1 MB single-line paragraph, when it is indexed, then every stored chunk is at or under MAX_CHUNK_BYTES.
Given an instruction file with a Russian word, when auto-memory search runs that word, then a hit is returned.
Given a symlink to ./..notes, when the directory is indexed, then it is included, while a symlink to ../x is still rejected.
Given a/.gitignore ignoring x, when the directory is indexed, then a/x is absent.
Given docs/top.md, When include docs/**/*.md, Then docs/top.md is included (** matches zero directories).
Given a ctx_execute cwd that no longer exists, When the call runs, Then it still runs with no crash; given FORCE_COLOR=1, Then stdout has no ANSI escape codes.
Given an already-running session, When a plugin event fires mid-session, Then no resume hint is injected (hint only fires at real session start).
Given Linux, When the server reads the parent PID, Then it reads /proc directly and spawns no ps process.
Given an MCP clientInfo.name of opencode, When the server detects the adapter, Then adapter=opencode.
Given a JSONC config with a URL string containing //, When the installer edits the file, Then the URL string and existing comments are both kept intact.
Given a large unranged Read is denied twice in one session, When the second deny fires, Then the hint text is shown only on the first deny of the session.
Given a Pi install, When ctx doctor runs, Then it checks the real ~/.pi/... paths, not a hardcoded legacy path.
Given a PowerShell tool call, When PreToolUse fires, Then the same routing hint text is shown as for an equivalent Bash call.
Given a SessionStart event on Pi, When the context is injected, Then the message role is system, never user.
Given a binary file Read, When ctx_stats totals savings, Then saved_bytes for that call is 0.
Given a shell command that exits 1 and writes to stderr, When ctx_execute returns, Then isError is true.
Given a multi-byte UTF-8 character split across two stdout chunks on the Pi MCP bridge, When the bridge decodes it, Then the character is reassembled intact.
Given 2 Pi sessions opened in 2 different project directories, When each session calls a ctx tool, Then each gets its own bridge scoped to the right project.
Given a ctx_execute call in session S over a shared server, When PostToolUse runs, Then the stats row is credited to S, not the server
Given a generated hooks.json for Antigravity, When Antigravity loads it, Then it validates against Antigravity's own hook schema.
Given a user-added hook already in the agent's settings, When v2 runs upgrade, Then the user hook is still present afterward.
Given a markdown fence containing an inner fenced code block, When the page is chunked, Then it stays one block with the inner fence intact.
Given a ctx_execute call, When it runs and finishes, Then it ran in the project cwd and its temp directory was cleaned up afterward.
Given a sibling session DB, When ctx_stats reads it, Then the DB is opened read-only and its mtime is unchanged afterward.
Given a call to an external tool named mcp__foo__bar, When PreToolUse runs, Then the hook fires and can route/hint on it.
Given a strict MCP host, When it calls ctx_search with {query:"x"}, Then the call succeeds because query is declared in the schema.
Given a freshly generated hooks config, When it is written at install, Then every hook entry carries a timeout value.
Given Windows with Git Bash, When ctx_execute runs a shell command that calls `where node`, Then it resolves node the same way the parent shell's PATH would.
Given 1000 project DBs on disk, When the server sits idle for 60 seconds, Then it opens 0 DBs outside its own session.
Given Windows where the only python on PATH is a #!/bin/sh shim, When ctx_execute runs python code, Then the code runs successfully.
Given a Node execPath under a versioned Cellar path, When install writes hook/MCP commands, Then the written command is a stable path, not pinned to that version.
Given a running ctx_execute call, When the host sends an abort/cancel signal, Then the child process tree is killed and the call returns a cancel reply.
Given journal events of mixed priority, When ctx_resume filters by minPriority, Then priority 1 (critical) events are always kept, under one priority polarity shared by journal and resume.
Given Pi injects a context-hook message, When the message is built, Then it carries a finite numeric timestamp.
Given a compound shell command such as a for-loop, When ctx_batch_execute runs it with NODE_OPTIONS preload set, Then the command still runs and produces correct output.
Given text with an emoji sitting at the cut point, When ctx_execute truncates output, Then the result is valid UTF-8 with no lone surrogate.
Given an unreachable URL, When ctx_fetch_and_index runs, Then the error is one line naming the cause, with no raw stack.
Given OpenCode 2.x, When the plugin loads, Then the ctx_* tools register successfully.
Given Windows, When the server starts, Then zero `where` probe processes spawn before initialize.
Given an opencode.json with 3 existing plugin entries, When upgrade writes the jsonc file, Then all 3 entries are still present.
Given Windows, When any probe or child process spawns, Then it sets windowsHide so no console window appears.
Given a Codex config with no [features].hooks key, When ctx doctor checks hooks, Then it reports hooks=true because `codex features list` says enabled.
Given ctx_execute without timeoutMs on the Pi adapter, When the code sleeps past EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS, Then the tree is killed and the timeout exit class is returned
Given an env var holding a token-shaped value, When a doctor/debug report is built, Then the value is redacted in the output.
Given an HTML table with a caption and no rows, When it is converted, Then the caption is kept and conversion does not throw.
Given a Codex tool call named exec, When PreToolUse runs, Then the hook fires for it.
Given a 5 MB FTS row, When ctx_search highlights it, Then the reply returns in under 1s with bounded bytes.
Given an install targeting Kiro, When the hooks config is written, Then it uses version:"v1" with a hooks array.
Given Codex, When the SessionStart resume hint is built, Then its text uses the mcp__...ctx_resume tool name form for that agent.
Given 10 KB indexed and 2 KB returned to the model, When ctx_stats computes reduction_pct, Then kept_out is 8 KB, counting returned bytes once.
Given Pi installed via npm, When doctor/install runs, Then it finds the install via PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR.
Given VS Code Remote-WSL where VSCODE_CWD points at the install dir, When the project root resolves, Then it resolves to the real workspace root (or a doctor error), not the install dir.
Given a Pi project with a deny rule in its permissions file, When the hook sees a matching call, Then it denies with the policy reason
Given a running ctx_execute call, When it is cancelled, Then the full child process tree is killed, including any abandoned grandchild processes.
Given the windows-latest CI cell, When KEEP-PASS and GP1-GP11 run, Then the cell ends inside the 10 min budget with no EPERM hang
Given a 50 KB ctx_execute output with no intent set, When ctx_search runs for a term in it, Then the hit is found and labelled as a session result.
Given Windows, When the parent PID is gone, Then the server's liveness guard detects it on its next tick and the server exits.
Given an indexing call over many bytes/chunks, When ctx_index/ctx_batch_execute ingest it, Then the ingested byte and chunk counts stay within the documented budget.
Given ctx_execute called with background:true and no timeout, When the call runs, Then it returns in under 2 seconds.
Given the server starts, When it runs, Then process.cwd() stays the launch cwd — the server never calls chdir.
Given the batch preload temp file is deleted by the OS, When ctx_batch_execute runs again, Then it recreates the file and still works.
Given bytes that were captured but not actually kept out of the model's context, When ctx_stats totals savings, Then those bytes are not counted as saved.
Given a claude.ai artifact URL, When the WebFetch replacement mechanism runs, Then the fetch is allowed by default through the allowHosts table, with the deny staying in force for every other host.
Given fewer queued jobs than the pool's concurrency limit, When runPool runs them, Then capped is false.
Given one chunk matches two different search queries in the same call, When ctx_search returns results, Then the chunk is printed once, not twice.
Given a standalone install, When the generated hook config names the ctx tools, Then every name uses the mcp__context-mode__ prefix.
Given a hook event where there is nothing to report, When the adapter builds its output, Then it has no additionalContext field, not an empty one.
Given a SessionStart resume hint truncated at a point where an emoji sits, When the hint is built, Then the text is valid UTF-16 with no lone surrogate.
Given a Codex config, When install writes it, Then CONTEXT_MODE_PLATFORM=codex is set.
Given a Bash command that exits 0 but whose output text contains the word Error, When the journal records the event, Then no error event is written.
Given one huge line with no natural break, When ctx_index chunks it, Then every chunk stays at or under the size cap.
